title: Technical Lead – Full-Stack & AI Applications (AWS)
description:
Company: Cosentus

Experience: 5+ years in software engineering, including experience leading developers

About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to lead the development and delivery of Zeus and related client applications. You’ll guide engineers, make technical decisions, and collaborate with our existing engineering leadership to build reliable, scalable software.

Key Responsibilities

• Own technical planning and delivery for assigned products and projects.

• Translate business and client requirements into technical specifications, tasks, and delivery milestones.

• Lead backend, frontend, and AI application development.

• Write and review production code, resolve complex issues, and maintain engineering standards.

• Design APIs, databases, integrations, and background processing workflows.

• Guide AWS architecture and collaborate on deployments, monitoring, reliability, and cloud costs.

• Coordinate with other technical leads to reuse platform capabilities and manage dependencies.

• Work with QA to define acceptance criteria, verify AI outputs, and prepare releases.

• Implement access controls and secure handling of sensitive data.

• Mentor developers, identify delivery risks, and communicate progress clearly.

Required Qualifications

• Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience.

• Experience leading developers and delivering production applications.

• Strong backend expertise in Python or Node.js.

• Working knowledge of React or Next.js and full-stack application architecture.

• Hands-on experience with AWS, relational databases, APIs, and third-party integrations.

• Experience with code reviews, automated testing, Git, Docker, and CI/CD.

• Ability to own delivery while remaining actively involved in development.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to clarify requirements with business stakeholders.

Good to Have

• Experience integrating LLMs through Amazon Bedrock or other model APIs.

• Experience with healthcare software, document processing, or workflow automation.

• Experience building platforms used by multiple client organizations.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Open role

Full Stack Engineer

Own the backend and the first AI agents on a live consumer app, from the Node API to the React Native screen.

DawerOne · Hybrid, Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month · Contract-to-hire, full-time, 6 months · 4+ years

Apply by email

**About the job**

You will join our product engineering team on a live consumer app for a North American client. The stack is Node and PostgreSQL on the backend, React Native on mobile, a managed cloud platform for deployments, payments, the web tooling around it, and the AI agents and LLM-powered features now coming into the product. Our clients are in North America and our engineering team is in Gurugram.

**You are the backend and agents owner on the team.**
You own delivery of your workstreams end to end, API through to the screen, and ship to production. The first agents on the roadmap are yours to build. A DawerOne senior lead holds architecture, priorities, and the critical engineering decisions, including mobile architecture. A second developer works alongside you on the React Native surface, a test automation engineer covers regression, payments, and notifications, and the client's product owner and QA lead are part of the day-to-day team.

About half your time goes to a second product in the same client portfolio: a Python and Flask backend on AWS with an AI layer, under the same senior lead. You do not need deep Flask or AWS expertise, but you need to be comfortable reading and changing that codebase from the start.

This is a
**contract-to-hire**
role: a
**full-time, six-month contract**
with DawerOne, converting to a permanent role on mutual fit. For a strong candidate with clear long-term alignment, we are open to full time from day one. It is
**hybrid**
: you work from home most of the month and from our
**Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month**
. Indore and Gurugram are preferred, but we will consider strong candidates elsewhere in India within travelling distance of either office. Compensation is benchmarked to seniority and we share a number in the first conversation. The top of our range goes to someone who has shipped a production agent and can show it.

**Responsibilities**

**First 30 days**

* **Ship a first feature end to end**
  , API through to the screen, within the first sprint.
* **Get the automated iOS and Android build and release pipeline working.**
* **Fix the highest-impact production issues:**
  payments, media handling, and performance across the API and database.
* **Scope the first agent**
  with the senior lead and the product owner: knowledge base, guardrails, cost model, and how it is evaluated.

**Backend and payments**

* **Build and maintain the Node and PostgreSQL backend and APIs**
  , including schema design and migrations.
* **Own the payment flows:**
  checkout, fees, onboarding, and payouts.
* **Integrate third-party services:**
  push notifications, media storage, and partner APIs.
* **Build web tooling where the product needs it:**
  admin portals and operational dashboards.

**AI agents**

* **Build and deploy AI agents and LLM-powered features:**
  agentic workflows against the backend, media analysis, and assisted content flows, using LLM APIs, tool use, and MCP.
* **Run them properly in production:**
  hosting, monitoring, cost control, and evals that tell you whether the agent is actually good.

**Features and mobile**

* **Deliver new features end to end:**
  scoping with the product owner, API design with the senior lead, the mobile build, and the release.
* **Ship React Native features and bug fixes**
  alongside the mobile developer, to patterns set by the senior lead.

**Builds, infrastructure, and operations**

* **Own builds, release management, and production deployments**
  on managed platforms such as Railway, Render, or AWS, with CI/CD for mobile and services.
* **Run the operations:**
  environments and secrets, monitoring, alerting and logging, backups and restore, and infrastructure cost, with infrastructure as code where it pays for itself.
* **Debug production issues**
  across backend, database, deployments, payments, and mobile.
* **Do performance work with measurements before and after.**

**Quality and delivery**

* **Support QA**
  with the automation engineer and the client's QA lead: regression, release validation, and bug fixing.
* **Keep Jira current:**
  blockers surfaced early, status up to date, and clear written updates.
* **Build with AI coding agents as a matter of course.**
  That is how we work.

**Minimum qualifications**

**What matters most**

For us, these matter most.

* You have
  **built and deployed at least one LLM-powered feature or agent to production:**
  prompt and tool design, structured outputs, handling failures, hosting and monitoring, controlling cost, and measuring quality. You can talk honestly about what did not work.
* **Daily, fluent use of AI coding agents**
  such as Claude Code, MCP servers, or similar. This is a hard requirement. You are productive with them from day one, with no ramp-up period.
* You can
  **debug a production issue independently across layers**
  before escalating.

**Experience**

* **4 to 6 years**
  building software, with strong backend experience:
  **Node**
  with Express or NestJS,
  **REST API design**
  , and
  **PostgreSQL**
  schema design and migrations.
* **Working Python**
  and comfort reading and changing a
  **Flask**
  codebase, plus basic
  **AWS**
  familiarity: EC2 or ECS, RDS, S3, and IAM. Deep Flask or AWS expertise is not required.
* **Production React Native experience:**
  shipped features and fixed bugs in a live app on iOS and Android, and able to work to an architecture someone else has set.
* **Hands-on with builds, CI/CD, and deployments:**
  GitHub Actions or similar for services, and you have owned environments, secrets, monitoring and alerting, and backups for a production service. Fastlane or EAS for mobile is a plus.

**Ways of working**

* You
  **take ownership of outcomes**
  , ask the right questions early, and keep delivery moving without follow-up.
* **Clear written English and Jira discipline.**
  You work directly with a North American product owner and QA lead.
* Able to work
  **roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST consistently**
  , Monday to Friday, and flexible if the window needs to move. This is a shift, not an occasional late call.
* Able to be in the
  **Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month**
  .

**Preferred qualifications**

* Deeper AWS operations, Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool, Docker in production, or Flask at scale.
* Stripe or another payment provider in production.
* Consumer commerce or payments-heavy products.
* Store releases, deep links, and push providers such as OneSignal or Firebase.
* Image or media processing flows.
* Experience working in an inherited codebase while still shipping features.

**Engagement details**

* **Engagement:**
  contract-to-hire. A six-month, full-time contract with DawerOne, converting to a permanent role on mutual fit. For a strong candidate with clear long-term alignment, we are open to full time from day one.
* **Time commitment:**
  full time, split roughly half and half between the primary consumer app (Node, PostgreSQL, React Native) and backend work on a second product in the same client portfolio (Python, Flask, AWS).
* **Exclusivity:**
  this is a full-time, exclusive engagement. You cannot hold another job or contract alongside it.
* **Location:**
  hybrid, with 2–4 days a month in our Indore or Gurugram office. Indore and Gurugram preferred; strong candidates elsewhere in India are considered if they are within travelling distance of either office and can travel for office days.
* **Working hours:**
  roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST, Monday to Friday, for daily overlap with the client's North American morning. The window may shift if the engagement demands it.
* **Start:**
  immediate joiners preferred. We do not buy out notice periods.
* **Reports to:**
  the DawerOne senior lead on the engagement.
* **Process:**
  a 30-minute screen with the hiring manager, a technical deep dive of 60 minutes or more, a 60-minute live assessment spanning a Node API, the React Native screen in front of it, and a small agentic workflow using your own AI tooling, and a 30-minute final conversation. The technical and live rounds may be combined. You hear back within two working days of applying, and we make an offer within a week of the live assessment for the right candidate.

**Who should apply**

Someone who has
**shipped a backend, a mobile feature, and an agent on products that mattered**
, and wants to own all three on one team with a senior lead who engages with the hard decisions rather than handing over a ticket list.

If you have not yet put an LLM-powered feature in front of real users, or you want to write application code and hand the deployments to someone else, this is probably not the right role yet.

**Apply**

Email us your resume. It is required. The button opens a ready-to-send email; attach your resume before sending. In the same email, answer all 6 questions below. Every answer is required; applications with unanswered questions are not accepted.

1. Which React Native apps have you built and shipped? Store links if possible.
2. Which backend technologies and databases have you worked with in production? Node is primary here; tell us how comfortable you are in Python and Flask as well.
3. Describe an LLM-powered feature or agent you built and deployed to production: what it did, how you handled failures, what it cost to run, and how you measured whether it was good.
4. How do you use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP servers or similar) in your daily work? Be specific.
5. Have you worked with Stripe or another payment provider? Which flows?
6. Working hours for this role are roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST. Can you keep those hours consistently, and are you available full time for a 6-month contract?

Apply by email

title: Platform Engineer — Healthcare AI Platform USA
description:
**Company:**
Cosentus

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

Cosentus is looking for a
**Senior Full Stack & AI Platform Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**system design, scalable architecture, microservices, full-stack development, and AI-powered applications**
.

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can independently design complex systems, develop application modules, integrate modern AI technologies, and take complete ownership from architecture through production.

A key challenge involves building scalable AI-powered healthcare applications capable of processing
**2,000–5,000 medical charts within a 1–2 hour peak processing window**
, ensuring performance, reliability, accuracy, and cost efficiency.

The ideal candidate should be strong in
**Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, microservices, distributed systems, OCR, RAG, and practical AI/LLM implementation**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable applications using
  **React.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB**
  .
* Own
  **High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD)**
  for complex modules, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Design high-throughput architectures using
  **asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, queues, caching, and parallel execution**
  .
* Build and optimize
  **AWS Lambda-based services**
  and integrate AI models using
  **Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Develop and scale
  **AI/LLM workflows, OCR pipelines, Vision AI, structured data extraction, and RAG systems**
  .
* Design scalable APIs, database schemas, background processing workflows, and communication between microservices.
* Implement
  **concurrency controls, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, fault tolerance, and monitoring**
  .
* Integrate
  **AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
  where required.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend services, databases, AI models, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of
  **development, deployment, performance optimization, and production troubleshooting**
  .

Core Technical Skills1. Full Stack Development & System Design

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**
* Distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing
* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling
* Authentication, authorization, security, and fault tolerance
* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

The candidate must be capable of
**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

2. Microservices, Distributed Systems & AWS

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.
* Working knowledge of
  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**
  .

Experience with
**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**
who can take ownership of architecture, development, AI integration, scalability, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate should be able to design distributed architectures, implement production-ready modules, optimize high-volume AI processing workflows, and solve complex engineering challenges independently.

* **Our highest priorities are system design, scalable backend architecture, microservices, AWS Lambda, and practical AI implementation.**

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk's tech platform serves citizens at national scale — helping ITI apprentices, students, and applicants access government entitlements and services via WhatsApp and the web. The platform handles thousands of concurrent users across multiple domains (apprenticeships, education, municipal services) and runs on Go backends, Python MCP servers, PostgreSQL databases, AI-powered agents, and modern web front ends.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and ship features end to end — from responsive user interfaces and admin dashboards to APIs, data models, and cloud deployment. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will work closely with the Solution Architect, the Technical Product Manager, and AI specialists to turn product requirements into reliable, secure, and well-documented software.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You are expected to write production-quality code across the stack, understand the trade-offs behind technical decisions, and leave every part of the codebase better documented than you found it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Front-End Development**

* Build responsive, accessible web applications and internal dashboards using React / Next.js and TypeScript.
* Translate Figma designs and product requirements into clean, reusable UI components with consistent state management.
* Integrate front ends with REST/GraphQL APIs, handling authentication, error states, and loading performance.
* Optimise page performance, cross-browser compatibility, and mobile responsiveness for users on low-bandwidth networks.
* Write unit and end-to-end tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress) for critical user flows.

**2. Back-End & API Development**

* Design and build RESTful/GraphQL APIs and microservices in Go and Python (FastAPI/FastMCP), with Node.js where appropriate.
* Model data and write efficient queries in PostgreSQL — schema design, indexing, migrations, and query tuning.
* Integrate third-party services: WhatsApp Business API, government portals, payment gateways, and LLM inference providers.
* Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, JWT, role-based access control) and secure API practices.
* Build background jobs, caching (Redis), and message-queue consumers to keep the platform fast under load.

**3. DevOps, Cloud & Code Quality**

* Containerise services with Docker and deploy to AWS (EC2, ECS/Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront).
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), automated testing, and database migration frameworks.
* Instrument services with logging, metrics, and alerting; take part in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-mortems.
* Participate in code reviews, uphold coding standards, and maintain test coverage for every feature you ship.

**4. Security, Compliance & Documentation**

* Follow secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10) and help close vulnerabilities identified in security audits and VAPT.
* Implement DPDP Act 2023 requirements in product features: consent flows, data minimisation, retention policies, and audit trails.
* Document APIs, system flows, data models, and deployment steps in version control so any engineer can pick up your work.
* Contribute to onboarding material and knowledge sharing so the platform does not depend on tribal knowledge.

**5. AI-Enabled Product Features**

* Build user-facing features on top of LLM-based agents, including chat interfaces, RAG workflows, and MCP tool integrations.
* Work with AI specialists on prompt engineering, response evaluation, and model-agnostic integration patterns.
* Collaborate with the Technical Product Manager on scope, user feedback, and technical feasibility trade-offs.
* Stay current on web, cloud, and AI tooling and recommend improvements to the team.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — YEAR 1**

* Ship multiple end-to-end features to production — front end, API, data layer, and deployment — with minimal hand-holding.
* Own at least one product module (e.g. user dashboard, admin console, or a citizen-facing web flow) as its primary engineer.
* Improve front-end performance and reliability measurably: faster load times, fewer production defects, and better test coverage.
* Every feature you build is documented, tested, and covered by CI/CD — new engineers can understand and extend it without your help.
* Contribute to security hardening and DPDP compliance work, with no critical vulnerabilities open in code you own.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience: 3–6 years building and shipping full-stack web applications in production.
* Front-end: Strong in JavaScript/TypeScript, React (Next.js a plus), HTML5, CSS3, and modern styling (Tailwind CSS or similar). Solid grasp of state management (Redux, Zustand, or React Query), responsive design, and web accessibility (WCAG).
* Back-end: Proficient in at least one of Go, Python (FastAPI/Django), or Node.js (Express/NestJS). Experience designing RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Databases: PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimisation, migrations); familiarity with Redis and NoSQL stores such as MongoDB or DynamoDB. Exposure to pgvector is a plus.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on with AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), Git workflows, and Linux fundamentals.
* Testing & quality: Writes unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; comfortable with code reviews and clean-code principles.
* Security: Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OAuth 2.0/JWT authentication, role-based access control, and secure handling of personal data.
* AI/LLM literacy: Has integrated, or is keen to integrate, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Bedrock, open-source models) into products; understands RAG and prompt-engineering basics.
* Collaboration & communication: Explains technical choices clearly to peers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders; documents decisions and makes them discoverable.
* Ownership mindset: Takes features from idea to production and owns their quality after release.

**NICE-TO-HAVES**

* Government, civic-tech, or social-impact product experience (compliance, data residency, auditability).
* WhatsApp Business API or other chat-platform integrations.
* Mobile or PWA development (React Native, Flutter, or Progressive Web Apps).
* Kubernetes, Terraform, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Observability tools: Datadog, CloudWatch, SigNoz, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Message queues and event streaming: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS.
* Multilingual / Indic-language UI and localisation experience.

**OUR iMHERO VALUES — WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

At RightWalk, thriving means living our six iMHERO values every day — as behaviours you can observe, not adjectives you can claim.

* Integrity — Do right, always. Report accurately even when results are bad, flag problems early, and never hide data issues or inflate impact.

**Must Have**

We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will be responsible for the day-to-day management, continuous improvement, and operational health of the learning technology stack that powers learner experiences and program delivery.
  
  
This includes supporting the LMS, key SaaS integrations (e.g., Marketo), reporting and data flows, and custom operational tooling.
  
  
You will work closely with programming teams, vendors, and firm Learning Technology colleagues to gather requirements, identify enhancement opportunities, maintain platform reliability, and coordinate delivery of technical improvements. You will help define and maintain the product roadmap for the GSR learning technology ecosystem, recommending priorities and enhancements based on user needs, operational considerations, and platform opportunities. You will help with major roadmap decisions, strategic tradeoffs, and platform evolution initiatives will be developed in partnership with and syndicated through the Learning Technology team to ensure alignment with broader firm technology strategy. Your success requires strong technical judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder coordination, and the ability to balance operational excellence with continuous platform improvement in support of the Global Social Responsibility (GSR) mission-driven learning programs.
  
  
You will support platform performance, resilience, integrations, security, and vendor-orchestrated delivery while partnering across program teams, firm functions, and external providers to deliver a high-quality learner experience at scale.
  
  
You will help define and maintain the technical product roadmap across the LMS, integrations, reporting, and operational tooling by gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, evaluating technical solutions, identifying automation and process improvement opportunities, assessing risks and dependencies, and contributing recommendations for future platform capabilities in partnership with the Learning Technology Product Manager.
  
  
You will serve as the day-to-day steward of the GSR learning technology ecosystem by monitoring platform health, coordinating incident response, supporting root-cause analysis, maintaining visibility into operational risks and dependencies, and driving continuous service improvement.
  
  
You will support learner, program, and operational data flows by translating reporting requirements into technical solutions, improving data quality and reporting usability, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
  
  
You will manage day-to-day platform operations, including configuration, integrations, release coordination, change management, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and lightweight technical enhancements while improving platform maintainability and supporting adoption of new capabilities.
  
  
You will serve as the primary day-to-day contact for technology vendors by coordinating issue resolution, managing vendor-delivered enhancements, monitoring service performance, supporting sourcing and renewal decisions, and ensuring alignment with firm technology governance, architecture, and security standards.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* University degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred
* 5+ years of experience in technical product management, platform operations, enterprise systems, learning technology, or a closely related field
* Experience supporting business-critical SaaS platforms, integrations, and enterprise technology ecosystems
* Working knowledge of LMS technologies, APIs, SSO/SAML, CRM/marketing automation integrations, data pipelines, reporting platforms, and cloud-based systems
* Experience with platforms such as Docebo, Marketo, AWS, Domo, Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, or comparable technologies
* Experience managing external vendors and service providers against SLAs, KPIs, roadmaps, budgets, and security/compliance expectations
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize work, manage multiple initiatives, and drive delivery in a fast-paced environment
* Product management skills, including requirements gathering, backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross-functional coordination
* Strong technical aptitude with experience supporting platform operations, integrations, automation, reporting workflows, and continuous improvement
* Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to leverage data, metrics, structured analysis, and GenAI-assisted tools to troubleshoot issues and implement practical solutions
* Sound judgment, adaptability, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, build productive partnerships, and escalate strategic decisions appropriately
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

title: We're Hiring: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and self-driven
**Full Stack Web Developer**
who can take ownership of our websites, student platforms and internal systems, and help us grow into a fully technology-driven education group.

**About Us**

**IMS (Institute of Mathematical Sciences), Delhi**

IMS is one of India's most trusted institutes for UPSC IAS/IFoS Mathematics Optional, led by
**K. Venkanna Sir**
with over 25 years of teaching experience. IMS has helped 300+ students get selected into the Civil Services, including IAS, IFoS and PCS. We offer offline and live online classroom programmes, Mains test series, study material, CSAT preparation, and coaching for CSIR NET, GATE and IIT JAM Mathematics — supported by a student portal, online admissions and a classroom app.

**K. Venkanna Junior College (KVC), Hyderabad**

KVC is an integrated Intermediate (MPC / BiPC) junior college that prepares students for IIT-JEE Main & Advanced, NEET UG, EAPCET and BITSAT alongside their Board exams. With IITian and Doctor faculty, small batches, a residential campus in Tarnaka, and AI-powered learning tools, KVC combines strong teaching with modern technology.

Both institutions share one vision: give every student the best guidance and the best tools to succeed. That's where you come in.

**What You'll Work On**

1. Website Development & Maintenance

- Manage, improve and maintain ims4maths.com (WordPress + Elementor) and kvenkannajuniorcollege.in (Next.js)

- Build new pages, landing pages for new batches and courses, and keep course, schedule and result information up to date

- Redesign sections for a cleaner, faster and more modern experience on both mobile and desktop

2. Online Test Series Platform

- Develop and improve our online test platform for UPSC Mains, JEE, NEET and EAPCET test series

- Build features for timed tests, answer-sheet uploads, evaluation workflows, detailed solutions and results

- Create rankings, performance reports and live leaderboards for students

3. Student & Parent Portals

- Build dashboards where students can track their tests, scores, weak topics and progress

- Develop a parent dashboard with weekly reports on attendance, test scores and study hours

- Integrate the student portal, website and classroom app so data flows smoothly between them

4. AI-Powered Learning Tools

- Improve and scale our existing AI features — AI doubt solver, AI quiz, adaptive mock test engine and AI study assistant

- Integrate LLM APIs (such as OpenAI) and connect them with our own question banks

- Explore new AI ideas that make learning faster and more personal for students

5. Admissions, Enquiries & Admin Panel

- Replace external forms (like Google Forms) with our own admission and enquiry system

- Build an admin panel for the team to manage leads, admissions, counselling requests and student records

- Set up automated email / WhatsApp / SMS notifications for enquiries, batch updates and results

6. Payments & E-commerce

- Integrate secure payment gateways (Razorpay or similar) for course fees, test series and study material orders

- Build order tracking, invoices and payment records

7. Performance, Security & SEO

- Make both websites fast, secure and fully mobile-responsive

- Handle hosting, backups, SSL, domains and subdomains

- Implement technical SEO best practices so more students can find us on Google

**Skills & Requirements**

- 4 years of hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer

- Strong command of React.js and Next.js, along with JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3 (Tailwind CSS is a plus)

- Backend development with Node.js (Express or NestJS) and building secure REST APIs

- Experience with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MySQL

- Good working knowledge of WordPress, PHP and Elementor

- Experience integrating payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree or similar)

- Familiarity with authentication, user roles and secure handling of student data

- Deployment and hosting experience on AWS, Vercel, DigitalOcean, cPanel or VPS

- Comfortable with Git and version control

- Understanding of website performance optimisation and technical SEO

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

- Good communication skills to work closely with the academic and admin teams

**Good to Have**

- Experience working with OpenAI or other LLM APIs and building AI-based features

- Prior experience building an LMS, online exam platform or test series system

- Mobile app development with React Native or Flutter

- Experience in the EdTech sector

- Basic UI/UX design skills (Figma)

- Knowledge of analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console

**Why Join Us**

- Real impact: your work directly helps thousands of students reach their goals in UPSC, JEE and NEET

- Full ownership: you'll lead the tech for two growing institutions, not just one small feature

- Direct access to leadership: quick decisions, no layers of approval — your ideas get built fast

- Freedom to innovate: choose the right tools, suggest improvements and shape our tech roadmap

- Growth opportunity: as our digital platforms expand, so will your role and responsibilities

- A respected brand: work with an institute that has a 25+ year legacy in education

**Salary: Negotiable (based on experience and skills)**

**Job Location: Old Rajinder Nagar, Karol Bagh, Delhi – 110060**

**Job Type: Full-time (Work from Office)**

**How to Apply**

Apply directly through this post. Please make sure your profile includes your
**resume**
, along with links to your
**GitHub, portfolio**
and live projects you've built — this helps us understand your work better.

We look forward to building the future of education with you!

description:
**Role Overview:**
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be a part of team that builds and scales proprietary tools that automate the full primary research / survey workflow — from selecting approaches and panels, through fielding and validation, to analysis and visualization of survey data. The broader group supports private equity work with specialized analytics products (survey analytics, digital diagnostics, workforce analytics, disruption assessment, etc.) and combines deep domain expertise with modern technology, including generative and agentic AI plus heavy data analytics.

**Experience:**
8-10 years for Manager and 10-13 years for Sr. Manager

**Key Responsibility:**

* Full ownership of architecture, quality, delivery speed, reliability, security, scalability, maintainability, and technical alignment across the portfolio.
* Defining the long-term technical vision and driving convergence toward shared infrastructure, common components, and consistent engineering practices.
* Guiding product-level engineering leads on architecture decisions, resolving cross-product dependencies and trade-offs, and ensuring strong execution.
* Building shared platform capabilities: authentication & authorization, hosting & deployment, CI/CD, observability, security scanning, API standards, shared data layers, reusable components, and cross-product integrations.
* Owning the portfolio’s security and data-governance approach (access control, data sharing, compliance, and responsible AI use).
* Staying hands-on in critical technical areas — designing and implementing shared components, APIs, integrations, production data and ML pipelines, asynchronous processing, and performance-sensitive infrastructure; contributing to individual product codebases when needed.
* Setting and maintaining engineering standards (architecture, code quality, automated testing, performance, observability, documentation, release management, production reliability).
* Shaping the architecture for AI/LLM capabilities across the products (RAG, semantic search, copilots and agents, enterprise model gateways, LLMOps, evaluation, and monitoring).
* Translating product and business needs into technical roadmaps and implementation plans, balancing user impact and timelines with scalability, security, quality, and cost; proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Building engineering capability: mentoring leads and developers, conducting architecture and code reviews, supporting technical hiring, evaluating new technologies, and encouraging reuse and knowledge sharing.

This is a hands-on leadership role — primary focus is engineering leadership across the portfolio, while remaining close to the technology on the most important shared and critical work.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong full-stack engineering experience:
* Server-side: FastAPI, Django, Flask, Node.js or similar.
* Client-side: React, Angular or Vue.js, plus solid HTML/CSS.
* Designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices; solid understanding of API design best practices; working knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization.
* Proven experience designing shared/platform infrastructure (common authentication, CI/CD, shared data layers) that multiple independent product teams build on.
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure or GCP; expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes); Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK or similar).

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.
* **Strong software fundamentals, especially in Python.**
  You write maintainable code, understand distributed systems and data infrastructure, and can investigate problems across the stack.
* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.**
  AI tools are part of how you build. You know how to give them useful context, review their output, and verify correctness. You remain accountable for the code, architecture, and user experience you ship.
* **Ownership beyond launch.**
  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

How to apply

Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you.

* Tell us about a product or feature you owned end to end: how you chose what to build, the scale and engineering challenges involved, and what you learned from users after launch.

description:

Mohan Estate, New Delhi

: 3 years

**The Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

What You'll Do

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

Examples of Problems You'll Tackle

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

Strong Plus

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

How You'll Be Evaluated

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

Why Join

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and
**over 2 Million+ members**
, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

**Examples of Problems You'll Tackle**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

**Why Join**

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

**We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.**

**Apply Now!**

* Strong team player, comfortable working independently, solid written and spoken English.

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms (partner isolation, tenant-scoped data access).

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!
